text: {"summary":"The on-call rotation is being paged repeatedly for conditions that resolve themselves, likely due to transient latency spikes being reported as breaches.","likely_cause":"According to the documentation, histogram-based latency estimates can over‑state the 95th‑percentile during sharp spikes (Excerpt [1]), and alerts that fire on high latency without considering overall user‑visible latency can generate unnecessary pages (Excerpt [2]). This combination can cause alerts to trigger on brief, self‑resolving traffic spikes.","confidence":"medium","next_action":"Review the latency alert definitions: switch from native histogram estimates to summary‑based quantile calculations or adjust histogram bucket boundaries to reduce estimation error; and modify alerts to fire only on user‑visible latency breaches as recommended in the alerting guidance (Excerpt [2])."}
